title: 해리 포터와 마법사의 돌
prompt:
INPUT: attach this book's beginning form card image (her closed state). If a second image fits, add her first approved form image for the face.

BOOK: «해리 포터와 마법사의 돌» by J. K. 롤링. mystery · 1990년대 영국(가상 마법 학교) · 프리벳가 → 다이애건 앨리 → 마법 학교 지하. Source scope: "『해리 포터와 마법사의 돌』(1997) 1권만 — 2권부터는 넣지 않는다".

SOURCE ONLY: this book is still under copyright — design only from its written text. Do not imitate costumes, armor, props, creature or character designs, emblems or color schemes from any film, series, game, animation or cover art based on it.

STYLE: 섬세한 선화 + 회화적 채색의 성인 판타지 삽화풍

Design notes in quotes may be written in Korean; read them as description, never render them as text.

OUTPUT: the OPEN state of the attached image — the climactic scene of this stage. Keep her face, hair, body, costume, camera, framing and subject scale. Change the world around her into this scene: "벽난로에서 수십 통의 편지가 소용돌이치며 방 안으로 쏟아져 나온다". She is the only person; the scene is carried by objects, environment, light, weather or a looming non-human presence. The pair must read as the same picture before and after the scene opens.

AGE: keep her age as in the attached image; add no wrinkles, folds or under-eye shadows, even when she smiles.

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border; pages and spines stay unlettered.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame.

HANDS: keep both hands as in the attached image.
